stations.title: Checkout
stations.text: Talks to the card company and to chance.

captions: Effie asks why Mrs Pellow was charged twice for one box last week.
Checkout talks to the card company and picks extras at random, and nothing tests it.
You stand in for chance and for the card company, and check every call it makes.
Now one box is one charge, and a declined card stays off Wendell's list.
Same checkout, no real cards. Your tests know every answer before they ask.
